text:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 - Cadmus Analytics (enterprise-cadmus-eu) - Increased 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Assigned: oncall-eng. Auto-escalate in 10m if not stable.

emma: I'm taking first touch. Reproducing and pulling traces now. Seen a deploy to runtime-v2.3.4 ~15m ago.

sanjay: I see the same. Backend runtime containers returning 502 from inference-worker when kv cache miss spikes. Gateway latency is spiking too. Attaching a quick log snippet:```
2023-11-18T14:20:10Z runtime-worker-7 ERROR inference request failed status=502 trace_id=abc123
```

maria: Cadmus account contacts for tailored comms: primary ops = ops@cadmus-analytics.internal (team: Cadmus Platform), exec escalation = legal-ops@cadmus.com, backup phone = +1-555-XXXX (obfuscated). CS lead is Anna Rivera (cs-anna). They are on EU business hours.

luke: Quick mitigation idea: revert runtime-v2.3.4 -> runtime-v2.3.3 (no schema change) and re-route production traffic to dedicated fallback pool (cadmus-dedicated-fallback) while we validate. Reversion should be <10m if build available.

emma: Starting rollback to v2.3.3 now. Posting draft status page update below — please edit: \n
"status page draft:"\nWe are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting Cadmus Analytics in eu-west-1 impacting generation requests. Our engineers are rolling back a recent runtime change and routing traffic to a fallback pool to restore service. We will provide updates within 30 minutes. Impact: intermittent 502 responses for API calls to /v1/generate.

maria: For Cadmus-specific notification (email/SMS) draft — keep concise and tailored: \n
"Cadmus Ops notification (draft):"\nHi Cadmus team,\nWe are experiencing intermittent 502 responses for generation requests in eu-west-1 beginning ~14:15 UTC. Our engineers have rolled back a recent runtime change and are routing traffic to a fallback pool to mitigate. You may see transient failures or increased latency for a subset of requests. We expect service stabilization within 30–60 minutes. We will follow up with a resolution note and post-incident summary. Contact: Anna Rivera (cs-anna) and oncall at Redwood.

cs-anna: Approve, please include an estimated ETA window and mention we will open a dedicated support bridge if requested. I'll queue the email template for Cadmus supportops.

ops_lead: @emma if rollback doesn't reduce errors in 10m, escalate to platform lead and enable live tracing for the problematic worker shard. Also prepare account-level follow-up with root cause hypothesis + timeline.

incident-bot: Escalation timer: 8m remaining before auto-escalate to ops_lead.

sanjay: Rollback completed at 14:32 UTC. Immediately scaled runtime pool by +2 nodes and warmed KV cache. Observed 5xx rate dropping from ~18% -> ~4% over last 6 minutes. Continuing to monitor.

emma: Monitoring p95 latency and error rate. Posting handoff summary for night oncall (if needed): \n- Issue: elevated 502s for Cadmus Analytics in eu-west-1 after runtime-v2.3.4 deploy.\n- Mitigation: rolled back to v2.3.3, scaled pool +2, warmed cache, routed traffic to cadmus-dedicated-fallback for heavy customers.\n- Current state: error rate reduced, partial recovery observed.\n- Next steps: keep traffic on fallback for 1h, enable extended logs for affected worker shards, draft RCA with timeline.

luke: Recommend status page go to "partial service degradation" for impacted endpoints and include the Cadmus-specific note. I can spin the support bridge if Cadmus asks.

maria: Sending Cadmus draft now (cs-anna to review after I send). Will add ETA 60 minutes and support bridge offer.

incident-bot: Note: Created incident ticket INC-20231118-2373 and linked oncall-runbook.

emma: Handoff: @sanjay I will leave monitoring and escalation with you for the next hour. I'll update postmortem skeleton and include customer-impact blurb for Cadmus. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Oncall acknowledged. I'll loop ops_lead if error rate rises above 7% again. Will post a follow-up in this thread at 15:30 UTC or sooner with status.

cs-anna: Confirmed Cadmus comms queued. Will send once we verify stability for 10m.

emma: Closing note for thread — please avoid external customer-facing links to internal logs. Use the drafted text only.

sanjay: Follow-up 15:02 UTC — 5xx rate holding at ~2.5%. No customer reports so far. Keeping watch.
